name: 萝卜 PPT
description_zh: 一句话把文章、口播稿、大纲做成可编辑的原生 PPT，也能照一张参考图把旧 PPT 美化得统一好看，原文一字不改。14 套风格可选，交付前自动检查丢字、溢出和对比度。
description_en: Turn a topic, article or outline into an editable native PowerPoint deck, or restyle an existing deck after a reference image without changing a single word. 14 built-in styles and automatic checks for missing text, overflow and contrast.
